# RoboFiesta'26

> RoboFiesta'26 is RVITM's student robotics festival in Bangalore, India. Its theme is “Where Circuits Come Alive,” and its primary message is “Build. Battle. Break Limits.”

## Official facts

- Dates: 16–18 October 2026
- Venue: RVITM, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Organizer: RVITM Robotics Community
- Audience: student builders, coders, creators, and robotics teams
- Format: in-person college robotics festival
- Prize details: TBA
- Registration fee: TBA; consult the official rulebooks when published

## Competition arenas

- Robo Wars — compact battle robots; teams of 2–5; advanced
- Micromouse Maze — autonomous maze navigation; teams of 1–3; intermediate
- Autonomous Rover — sensor-based terrain navigation; teams of 2–4; advanced
- Drone Dash — racing through gates; teams of 1–2 pilots; intermediate
- Line Follower X — speed and precision track challenge; teams of 1–3; beginner
- Innovation Expo — student prototype showcase; teams of 1–4; beginner
